title: Subscription Billing & Refund Policy
text: Standard tier subscriptions include a 30-day full refund window from the initial purchase date. Pro tier subscriptions are eligible for a prorated refund within 14 days. Enterprise tier annual contracts are strictly non-refundable once provisioned, though unused credits can be reallocated across workspaces.

title: API Rate Limits & Throttling
text: Public REST API endpoints enforce a default rate limit of 120 requests per minute for Standard plans and 600 requests per minute for Pro plans. Enterprise workspaces support 5,000 requests per minute with burst capacity up to 8,000 requests. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP status 429 Too Many Requests with a Retry-After header.

title: CLI Administration & 2FA Recovery
text: Organization owners can reset two-factor authentication (2FA) for a locked-out member using the admin CLI command `vaultctl auth mfa-reset --user <email> --reason-code SEC-402`. This command revokes all active session tokens immediately and sends a one-time hardware key enrollment link.

title: Data Encryption at Rest and in Transit
text: All customer vector indexes and document blobs are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM with keys rotated automatically every 90 days. Data in transit requires TLS 1.3; TLS 1.1 and TLS 1.2 connections are rejected at the edge proxy. Customer-Managed Keys (CMK) via AWS KMS are supported only on Enterprise plans.

title: Webhook Delivery & Exponential Backoff
text: When a customer webhook endpoint returns a 5xx server error or times out after 10 seconds, the event dispatcher retries delivery up to 6 times using exponential backoff starting at 30 seconds. After 6 consecutive failures over 8 hours, the webhook endpoint is automatically disabled and marked unhealthy.

title: Audit Logs & Zero Data Retention (ZDR)
text: By default, inference trace logs are retained for 30 days on Standard and Pro tiers for debugging. Audit security logs are retained for 365 days. Zero Data Retention (ZDR)—where prompts and completions are never written to disk—is disabled by default and requires signing an Enterprise BAA addendum.

title: Single Sign-On (SSO) & SCIM Provisioning
text: SAML 2.0 and OIDC Single Sign-On (SSO) are available on Pro and Enterprise plans. Automated user provisioning and deprovisioning via SCIM 2.0 is restricted exclusively to Enterprise plans and syncs group membership every 15 minutes.

title: Vector Index HNSW Tuning Parameters
text: The default HNSW vector index uses `m=16` and `ef_construction=200` with cosine distance. At query time, the default search depth is `ef_search=64`. Increasing `ef_search` to 128 improves Recall@10 by approximately 4.2% at the cost of 18ms additional p99 query latency.

title: Troubleshooting Error Code ERR_IDX_809
text: Error code `ERR_IDX_809` occurs when an ingestion batch contains embedding vectors whose dimension does not match the collection schema (for example, sending 1536-dim vectors to a 768-dim index). Resolve this by running `vaultctl collection migrate --reembed` or specifying `--dim 1536` at creation.

title: Regional Data Residency & Cross-Border Replication
text: Workspaces pinned to the `eu-central-1` (Frankfurt) region store all primary shards and daily snapshots strictly within Frankfurt availability zones. Cross-region replication outside the EU is prohibited and cannot be enabled even by organization administrators.

title: Uptime SLA & Service Credit Schedule
text: Enterprise workspaces carry a 99.99% monthly uptime SLA. If Enterprise monthly uptime falls between 99.90% and 99.99%, Enterprise customers receive a 10% service credit. If Enterprise uptime drops below 99.0%, customers receive a 30% service credit. Standard tier workspaces do not carry a financially backed uptime SLA.

title: Disaster Recovery, RPO, and RTO Targets
text: Production database clusters take continuous WAL snapshots with a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of 5 minutes and a Recovery Time Objective (RTO) of 30 minutes for regional failover. Point-in-time recovery (PITR) allows restoring to any second within the last 14 days.

title: Self-Hosted Kubernetes Helm Deployment
text: To deploy the local NLI reranker pod on GPU nodes in Kubernetes, pass `--set reranker.gpu.enabled=true --set reranker.resources.vramMinGb=8` during `helm upgrade --install`. Minimum supported NVIDIA driver version is 535.104 with CUDA 12.1.

title: GraphQL API v1 Deprecation Notice
text: The legacy `/v1/graphql` endpoint is deprecated and read-only as of Q2. All mutation operations must use `/v2/rest/mutations` or the gRPC ingestion stream on port 9443. Queries to `/v1/graphql` will be permanently sunset on December 31.

title: Workspace RBAC Roles & Permissions
text: The `Auditor` role grants read-only access to billing invoices, security logs, and evaluation reports but cannot view raw document chunks or execute API queries. The `Member` role can run queries and upload documents, while only `Owner` and `Admin` roles can delete collections or rotate API keys.

title: General Billing FAQ & Invoice Cycles
text: Monthly invoices are generated on the 1st of each calendar month. Customers can pay via ACH, wire transfer, or credit card. Late payments accrue a 1.5% monthly fee after a 30-day grace period.

title: Installing the vaultctl CLI Tool
text: Install `vaultctl` on macOS using `brew install vaultctl` or via pip with `pip install vaultctl-cli`. Authenticate your local terminal session by running `vaultctl login --sso`.

title: Python SDK Client Configuration
text: The Python SDK client defaults to a 60-second request timeout and 3 automatic retries for network connection resets. Configure custom timeouts via `Client(timeout=30.0, max_retries=5)`.
